description:
Show the property's official photos of the house as an interactive card in the chat.

Use when the guest wants to SEE the house, the sauna/wellness area or the outside of the building —
instead of a web image search, which finds other businesses named 'Prägant'. Same behaviour (read-only)
and result as get_region_info for the topic, plus the photos in the card.

language.description: Answer language: 'de' (default) or 'en' — use the language of the conversation. Text and card are always in the same language.
language.title: Language

topic.description: 'house' = all official house photos (outside view summer/winter, sauna, steam bath, relaxation room …); 'wellness' = only the wellness rooms
topic.title: Topic
